supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — Take Off After Left Back Pulls the Wing Defender Inside
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: WD still inside on LB; take-off lane toward middle free
supersededFamilies.decision: Take off now; finish from GK read, not from folklore
supersededFamilies.note: 944 is the earned take-off family (3:2:1 half-step picture)

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — Ask for the Ball When the Wing Defender’s Hips Open the Lane
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: WD hips face LB; pass lane from LB to LW open
supersededFamilies.note: 942 earns LB ask + 5:1 advance width in one native family

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — Read Feet and Chest Before Your First Movement
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: WD feet point inside or chest opens to ball
supersededFamilies.decision: Choose stay-wide / ask / prepare back-door from that cue

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — Early Step-Out: Lob Only If Hands Drop and Inside Is Covered
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: GK steps out; hands/height and LB availability stated
supersededFamilies.decision: Conditional lob OR soft inside — never automatic lob

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — Partially Set Defence: One More Advantage Action
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: Defence half-set; WD late on left
supersededFamilies.decision: One more advantage action vs full reset
supersededFamilies.note: 947 teaches one-more left action while WD late

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — 6v5: Feed the Sealed Pivot Before Rotation Closes
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: Pivot sealed; late middle rotation coming
supersededFamilies.decision: Feed pivot / attack rotation — distinct from free finish
supersededFamilies.note: 948 is stay-wide vs enter onto own pivot in 6v5

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — 5:1: Time Width Against the Advanced Defender
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: Advanced defender position relative to LB/LW lane
supersededFamilies.decision: Ask/hold width vs premature entry — would differ in 6:0

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — 3:2:1: Wing vs Half Responsibility Window
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: Half steps out; wing responsibility lag stated
supersededFamilies.decision: Exploit lag / hold for LB — system-specific

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — Recover Back to the Wing After Inside Help
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: Help done; ball reversing to opp wing
supersededFamilies.decision: Sprint recover to wing before skip arrives
supersededFamilies.note: 949 is stronger sequence-native version; do not also build generic recover-after-help

supersededFamilies.titleEn: Left Wing — After Turnover With Empty Own Goal: First Sprint Priority
supersededFamilies.primaryCue: Own GK out; turnover; opp numbers/lane stated
supersededFamilies.decision: First defensive sprint priority (lane/body) — not hero foul folklore

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Stretch Wider When Left Back Binds the Wing Defender
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: LB engages WD; WD hips still on LB
remainingBuildList.decision: Stay/maximize width to keep the pass alive

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Stay Wide When the Wing Defender Helps Inside
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: WD chest/hips turn inside to help on LB
remainingBuildList.decision: Stay wide; do not follow into the crowded half

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Enter Only When the Left Lane Actually Opens
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: WD overcommits to ball side; path to six opens
remainingBuildList.decision: Timed entry toward six

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — When NOT to Leave the Corner for an Entry
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: WD already helping / lane closing; LB still needs width
remainingBuildList.decision: Stay wide; early entry kills LB space
remainingBuildList.note: 945 is exit second pivot; 948 is 6v5. Still need set-play when-NOT-to-enter from corner.

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Back-Door When the Wing Defender Ball-Watches
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: WD head/chest to far ball; LB about to receive
remainingBuildList.decision: Cut behind WD to six on next pass

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Closed Take-Off Lane: Do Not Force the Jump
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Half/WD recover into take-off line; contact imminent
remainingBuildList.decision: Delay / recycle / soft inside — do not jump into block

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Delay the Ask When the Pass Lane Is Covered
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: WD feet/chest cut the LB→LW lane
remainingBuildList.decision: Hold width; do not force the ask into a steal

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Pivot Block Opens Take-Off Toward the Middle
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Pivot seals WD recovery path
remainingBuildList.decision: Take off into freed lane; then read GK

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Feed the Sealed Pivot Instead of Forcing the Extreme Angle
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Pivot sealed; WD recovers on LW body; soft inside lane open
remainingBuildList.decision: Feed pivot vs forced wing shot

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 1v1 When You Own the Sideline Space
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: WD isolated; help distance >2m; feet flat
remainingBuildList.decision: Attack 1v1 take-off / beat vs recycle

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Goalkeeper Commits Early to the Near Post
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Before take-off: GK near foot and near arm move to near post
remainingBuildList.decision: Available target is far side — contextual, not folklore

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Goalkeeper Shades the Far Side Early
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: GK far foot/weight committed far; near window opens
remainingBuildList.decision: Near-side finish if lane and body allow — cue-based

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Goalkeeper Depth Changes the Finish Window
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: GK deep on line vs stepped; arms high/low stated
remainingBuildList.decision: Finish choice from depth + hands, not automatic lob/power

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Wait Through the Goalkeeper’s Late Movement
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: GK late first step during take-off; contact not yet forcing release
remainingBuildList.decision: Patience to abandoned corner vs early release into hands

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Extreme Angle: Body and Goalkeeper Cue Before Release
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Sliver of goal + GK shade + help distance
remainingBuildList.decision: Playable skim / recycle — hand tag only if fork is hand-dependent

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — First Wave 2v1: Finish or Extra Pass
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Numbers 2v1; recovering defender commits to ball or LW
remainingBuildList.decision: Shoot vs give the extra pass

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — First Wave 3v2: Hold the Left Width
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Middle covered by recovering defender; left lane free
remainingBuildList.decision: Stay wide to six as pass option — do not crowd middle

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — First Wave: Arrive With the Catch on the Six
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Outlet released; one recovering body between LW and six
remainingBuildList.decision: Sprint timing so catch and six arrive together

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Second Wave: Stop Forcing When Advantage Is Gone
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Recovering defenders restore numbers; no free lane
remainingBuildList.decision: Hold width into positional attack
remainingBuildList.note: 947 is keep-one-more when WD late. Need opposite: stop when advantage gone.

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Choose the Left Running Lane Against Recovery
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Recovery path of nearest defender stated
remainingBuildList.decision: Wide lane vs inside lane to keep the advantage

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 6v5: Finish When Free and Help Is Late
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Nearest help >2m from take-off; LW free at width
remainingBuildList.decision: Finish now
remainingBuildList.note: 948 is stay-wide vs entry. Still need free-finish when help is late.

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 5v6: Do Not Donate a Counter From the Corner
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Down a player; WD closing; risky extreme angle
remainingBuildList.decision: Safe recycle / high-percentage only

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Extra Attacker / Empty Opponent Goal: Only If the Left Picture Is Clean
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Extra attacker or empty opp goal PLUS concrete LW freedom/risk
remainingBuildList.decision: Finish vs keep possession discipline

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Empty Own Goal: Safe Finish or Safe Return
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Own goal empty; catch quality / body orientation / opp wing threat stated
remainingBuildList.decision: High-percentage finish vs safe return

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Passive Warning: Create a Real End, Not a Panic Shot
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Passive signal; WD distance; LB/pivot options
remainingBuildList.decision: Best real end from width vs panic extreme

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Late Lead: Do Not Gift the Counter From a Marginal Angle
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Lead late + marginal angle + turnover risk stated
remainingBuildList.decision: Safe recycle / clear high-% only — risk changes the decision

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Late Trail: Take the Clean Chance You Are Given
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Trail late + free take-off / clear cue
remainingBuildList.decision: Take the clean chance vs over-reset

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Short Clock: One Decision From the Stated Picture
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Clock + concrete freedom or blocked lane
remainingBuildList.decision: Immediate end vs impossible force

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 3:3: Release From Man Pressure Without Crowding LB
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Man pressure on LW; help/switch picture
remainingBuildList.decision: Width release / back-door / recycle

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 4:2: Attack the Left Corridor Timing
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Front line vs back line gap on left
remainingBuildList.decision: Entry/take-off timing unique to 4:2

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 1:5: Keep Outlet Width Under Deep Pressure
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Deep press / high chase on left outlet
remainingBuildList.decision: Safe width outlet vs trapped ask

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 5+1: Do Not Walk Into the Long-Range Trap
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Advanced chaser + base wall on left
remainingBuildList.decision: Width/timing that differs from plain 6:0

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 4+2: Choose the Open Left Lane
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Two advanced defenders create a specific left gap
remainingBuildList.decision: Lane choice / ask timing

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Open Defence: Attack Isolation or Reject Crowding Help
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Man orientation + help distance
remainingBuildList.decision: 1v1 attack vs reset — distinct from structured 6:0 entry

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Finish Before the Recovering Defender Closes
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Recovering body one step away; GK position concrete
remainingBuildList.decision: Immediate controlled finish vs wait for contact

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Protect the Pass to the Opposing Wing
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Ball on opposite/backcourt moving to opp RW
remainingBuildList.decision: Deny wing pass / body on lane

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Controlled Inside Help Without Abandoning the Wing
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: LB threat inside; opp wing still a pass threat
remainingBuildList.decision: Help distance vs full abandon

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Handover Timing With the Half Defender
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Handover call / half arrives; ball side stated
remainingBuildList.decision: Release only after handover is real

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — When NOT to Abandon the Wing
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Opp wing free / ball reversing; help already present inside
remainingBuildList.decision: Stay; do not chase middle

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Defend Left Back / Wing Cooperation on Your Side
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Opp LB binds you then looks wing
remainingBuildList.decision: Body/chest on pass + communicate half

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Defend the Opposing Wing Entry
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Opp wing starts entry behind you
remainingBuildList.decision: Contact/deny path vs ball-watch

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Deny Back-Door When You Ball-Watch
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Temptation to watch far ball; opp wing behind
remainingBuildList.decision: Chest/feel contact; do not lose the runner

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Transition Defence: Close Your Own-Side Passing Lane
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Turnover; opp outlet toward your former wing side
remainingBuildList.decision: Sprint cut own-side lane first
remainingBuildList.note: 949 starts from second-pivot. Still need a normal transition own-side lane from wing-start (distinct geometry).

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Transition Defence: Far Skip Only With a Teammate Map
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Teammate locations stated; far-wing skip is real threat
remainingBuildList.decision: Cut far skip vs protect own wing — A/B must not both be correct

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — Communicate With the Half Before You Leave
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Half position + call/no-call
remainingBuildList.decision: Help only after communication / confirmed cover

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 6:0: Basic Wing Responsibility
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Set 6:0; ball far; opp wing width
remainingBuildList.decision: Primary wing job before freelancing

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 5:1: Wing Job Against the Advanced Pair
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Advanced defender interactions with your side
remainingBuildList.decision: System-specific stay/help — differs from 6:0

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 3:3: Switch / Stay on Man Pressure
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Stated team switch rule + runner
remainingBuildList.decision: Switch vs stay — rule must be in situation text

remainingBuildList.titleEn: Left Wing — 5v6 Defence: Protect the Most Dangerous Pass First
remainingBuildList.primaryCue: Down a defender; most dangerous pass stated
remainingBuildList.decision: Priority cover without gambling the wing randomly
